name: Swapping Party
original_name: スワッピングパーティー
source: Yuuma and his girlfriend Hiromi. Yamato and his girlfriend Himari. They've been friends for years. One day while staying at their friends Yuuma and Hiromi catch Himari and Yamato having sex so Himari suggests having sex together where they can watch each other. Next, to add excitement she suggests swapping partners. However when it turns out that Yamato is far better at satisfying his girlfriend Hiromi than he is, Yuuma feels inadequate as a lover.
translation:
悠真和女友广美、大和和女友日葵是多年的朋友。某天，悠真和广美留宿朋友家时，发现日葵与大和正在做爱。日葵提议四人一起做爱，彼此观赏。为了增加刺激，她又提议交换伴侣。

然而，当发现大和比自己更能让女友广美满足时，悠真开始觉得自己不是一个合格的恋人。
